newsitem.title: UK: Charter adds to recent gains in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Charter adds to recent gains in heavy trade.

text.p: Shares in Charter Plc added to their recent good run on Monday morning, aided by weekend press comment, dealers said.
Charter, the rail track equipment and welding products firm, saw its shares up 18p at 807p bid by 0915 GMT in heavy trade of nearly a million shares.

The Sunday Telegraph newspaper said Charter's acquisition of Howden, due to be voted through by shareholders this week, should see Charter "move out of the downtrodden, diversified, industrials sector into the more appropriate engineering segment".
Such a sector switch "should add 200p to Charter's share price before any of the benefits from the Howden deal start to flow," the paper added.
The stock dipped to lows in the 770s recently after hitting a year's high of 855p on March 21 in the wake of an agreed 378 million stg bid for industrial ventilation group Howden Group.
Charter last week announced its bid for Howden and attracted acceptances representing 66.6 percent of Howden shares, taking its total to 76.6 percent.
Announcing the agreed bid in March, Charter chairman and chief executive Jeffrey Herbert said the acquisition would boost earnings in its first year.
